description: UK annual allowance check for 2026/27: the tapered annual allowance (no taper at threshold income of £200,000 or less; otherwise £1 off the £60,000 allowance per £2 of adjusted income over £260,000, minimum £10,000), unused allowance carried forward from the 3 previous years (earliest first), the excess, and the annual allowance charge at your marginal rates; Scheme Pays is available for charges over £2,000. Reproduces HMRC's Sybille, Sam, Frances and Tracey examples. Use this when someone asks whether they will pay an annual allowance charge or how much carry forward they have.
